title: Quick Seared Canadian Hail Battered Salmon Skillet
description: A jammy and crisp Canadian dish featuring hail battered salmon, nimono simmered in a cast iron skillet, sugar free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the cast iron skillet over medium high heat.
In a bowl, mix together hail batter mix, soy sauce, and lemon juice.
Add the salmon fillets to the bowl and coat with the hail batter mix.
Add olive oil to the preheated skillet and swirl it around.
Add the coated salmon fillets to the skillet and sear for 3 minutes on each side.
Remove the salmon from the skillet and set aside.
Add nimono broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Add garlic powder, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir.
Return the salmon to the skillet and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the salmon hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
